context: deploy — every generated text is editable in Experience Workspace. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: node_slotting_no_value_slotting
checklist.description: No block copies authored text into generated markup: no `textContent =`/`innerHTML =` assignments or template-literal interpolation whose source is an authored element; template-slotted blocks hold empty slot containers and MOVE the authored elements into them (Step 2b node-slotting).

checklist.name: move_not_rebuild
checklist.description: Every authored h1–h6/p/ul/ol/picture is placed with append()/prepend()/before(); no cloneNode+discard, no retagging, no .trim()/normalisation of displayed text; sibling walks capture nextElementSibling before append() (EW1).

checklist.name: wrapper_descendant_selectors
checklist.description: Layout classes live on generated wrappers; block CSS styles authored elements as wrapper descendants (`.headline :is(h2, h3)`), with no class on the authored element and no child combinator or positional pseudo-class between a wrapper class and an authored element (EW2/EW10).

checklist.name: cta_paragraph_moves
checklist.description: CTAs move as their paragraph (`a.closest('p') || a`); card-as-link blocks unwrap the inner anchor in the live DOM after reading its href; no manufactured button anchors (EW3/EW6).

checklist.name: clones_stripped_interactive_hosts
checklist.description: Presentational clones (loop slides, marquee copies) pass through stripInstrumentation(); no authored text is hosted inside a <button>/<summary> (EW4/EW7).

checklist.name: foundation_edit_mode_snippets
checklist.description: styles/styles.css ships the `.prosemirror-editor` CTA repaint from <strong>/<em> marks (on-media variants last), `a .prosemirror-editor a:any-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none }`, and `:where()` wrapper variants at equal specificity for every styled-text-link utility introduced (Step 3).

checklist.name: ew_gate_run_and_green
checklist.description: block-roundtrip runs with --ew on (per block and whole page) and ew-editability-probe.mjs --content runs before done: evidence on disk/in the log shows dead = 0 outside declared @ew-exempt and duplicated = 0; --no-ew is not used to pass.

checklist.name: gate_result_recorded
checklist.description: Before 'ready to push' the report quotes the whole-page probe totals from the ew-editability-probe.mjs --json artifact (authored / editable / dead = 0 outside declared exemptions / duplicated = 0) and, in a rollout, the row is ingested with update-coverage.mjs --gate editability <json> — the result is recorded, not asserted (rollout measured-gates.md § Gate 6).

checklist.name: edit_mode_simulation_clean
checklist.description: ew-editability-probe.mjs --simulate-editor reports no font/colour/line-height drift per text and block height Δ ≤ 2 px.

checklist.name: harness_identity_checked
checklist.description: The Local-QA harness is served on the project's allocated harness slot (`aem up --port $(node skills/replica/scripts/port.mjs harness)`, 3100–3199) and qa-gate.mjs asserts the served identity (build-harness's stardust/.work/harness/marker.txt, --marker) before reading a page; a mismatch is exit 4 = no verdict, never reported as a FAIL or a PASS.

checklist.name: exemptions_declared
checklist.description: Any dead text is declared with an @ew-exempt JSDoc tag in one of the three categories (metadata / derived / index-driven) and recorded in the conversion log; nothing is dropped silently.

checklist.name: fidelity_not_traded
checklist.description: The role round-trip still closes (0 structural 🔴) and the published render is unchanged — editability was not achieved by rendering less.
